recommendation: Implement comprehensive screening and referral for housing insecurity
implementation_steps: Screen for social determinants of health using structured tools
Coordinate referrals to community-based housing organizations
Provide regular follow-up and facilitate warm handoffs to ensure connection
Monitor appointment adherence and address transportation barriers
Support care plan implementation with attention to housing stability needs
evidence_summary: Care coordinator-led screening and referral interventions have demonstrated improvements in connecting patients to housing resources and addressing barriers to care related to housing insecurity.
